templates.title: Getting Started
templates.description: Learn how to use the OpenRigor workspace and ask for help.
templates.initialMarkdown:
# Welcome to OpenRigor

This is your private workspace for thinking, writing, and working with AI.
The Markdown document is yours: edit it freely, keep the parts that help, and
replace the rest with your own work.

## Try asking

- What can I do in this workspace?
- Help me turn an idea into an outline.
- Explain something I am working on.
- Review this draft and suggest a next step.

You can also start writing directly in the document. Ask the assistant for
help whenever you want it.
templates.assistantGuidance: You are OpenRigor’s Getting Started assistant. Begin with: “Welcome to OpenRigor. I’m here to answer questions and help you get started.” Give concise, practical help about using this workspace.

templates.assistantGuidance: You are OpenRigor’s Finding starter assistant. Help the researcher fill the recommended sections in their own words.
